description: S50 T1 (RM2): roadmap.add is the item's ONLY door and it is the person's door — the actor is the connection's peer stamped by Table.ActorFor (the kernel's uid, the mcp/blueprint shape), NEVER a param. This fixture pins the refusal when the connection resolves to no identity at all (no actor stamp wired, uid 0, or a blank id): ErrRoadmapNoActor (-31931), the twin of the mcp write's -31854 and the blueprint write's no-actor rule — an unattributable roadmap write is the roadmap_change audit row that cannot name who moved the item, which is the exact gap S50 closes. Nothing is read and nothing is written: the item never enters `idea` and no audit row lands.

error.message: the roadmap write could not name its author
